Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won 3v1 on Day 5, mainly because of exact-role surveys and visit-graph information. On N2 Judy's Kitsune charm swallowed the Katana attack aimed at Carol. That kept Carol alive to survey the Wiretap (Bob/Dave/Erin) and the Pharmacist (Dave/Erin/Grace). On Day 3 Ivan's Scout groups broke Heidi's fake "moved my trap to Carol" claim, and the town hanged her. She was really the Executioner, so removing her was useful, though the same hang also gave Frank (Bounty Hunter) his second bounty and his win. The Village's worst mistake came on N3: Ivan used his Armed shot on Dave, a real Auditor, on a 50/50 read between Bob and Dave. Judy had planned to release her swallowed attack on Dave for the same reason. On N3 the Yakuza also killed Judy and blocked her on the same visit, which correctly took out the protector after their failed attack. On Day 4 Erin threw away a plausible "I blocked Judy" story. She claimed "no block", which left an unexplained visitor, and then pushed a false "therefore Grace" deduction. She was hanged. On N4 the Yakuza moved the Katana to Bob because they thought Alice had "cleared" him and would not visit him again. Alice visited Bob for the third night in a row, so her Enforcer attack killed him while the Katana killed her. Only Niaj was left, and his fake tracks gave him away. His N3 "Dave visited no one" contradicted Dave's will ("audited Bob"). Bob's fake Fortune Teller count had backed Niaj and left Dave's visit out. Every earlier "confirmation" Niaj gave had repeated a claim that was already public. Finally, he had announced he would track Grace, so a guilty Grace would simply have stayed home that night. Carol and Ivan worked this out and hanged Niaj.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: low, harness bugSetup shows '[ERROR tips_stale] tips/tips.md was last checked against an older version of the rules', yet the tips file was still given to all 13 players, so they may have received out-of-date strategy advice.
Review: low, harness bugThe Night 2 [Moderator summary] is logged twice in a row with slightly different wording (duplicated log entry).
Review: low, player confusionDay 2: Ivan reasoned that because Olivia and Mallory 'visited' him, the Katana holder and the Bounty Hunter must be in his Scout group, clearing Frank and Grace. That ignores the chance that the victims' visits were blocked or fake. Mallory was actually role-blocked, and Frank was the Bounty Hunter. Grace and Niaj corrected this later in the day.
Review: low, player confusionDay 3: Bob's breakdown of his own (fabricated) Fortune Teller numbers left out the Katana holder's visit to Carol, so he concluded there was an extra unexplained visitor. Carol pointed out the error, and Bob conceded it was a miscount of the visitor rules.
Game over
